output.titleEn: RFQ for concrete materials: Portland cement, coarse sand, stone size No. 2

output.descriptionEn: Suppliers are invited to quote for the concrete materials listed: Portland cement Type 1 in 50 kg bags, coarse sand, and stone size No. 2. Please quote a unit price in Thai baht for each line.
